name: H05_hare_apparent_one_other_hare_makes_one_rabbit
note: Hare Apparent: 'When this creature enters, create a number of 1/1 white Rabbit creature tokens equal to the number of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent.' P0 already controls one Hare Apparent and casts a second with exactly its cost ({1}{W}): one other Hare Apparent, so exactly one 1/1 Rabbit (the entering Hare does not count itself).
